statements.t: We continue to expect our SG&A expense to remain substantially consistent.
We expect our R&D expense to increase as we progress our development activities.
Based on our current operating plans and projections, the Company expects to fund future operations with existing cash or cash flows from operating activities.
If necessary, we intend to raise additional capital through equity or debt financings.
We can provide no assurance that additional financing will be available to us on favorable terms, or at all.
